title.value: BIAS: Transparent reporting of biomedical image analysis challenges
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: BIAS: Transparent reporting of biomedical image analysis challenges

analysis.description: The paper discusses the importance of standardized reporting in biomedical image analysis challenges to ensure transparency and reproducibility. It introduces the BIAS initiative and provides guidelines and a checklist for documenting these challenges effectively.

type.justification: The paper focuses on establishing guidelines and recommendations rather than empirical analysis or experiments.
type.quote: As a first step towards better scientific practice, this paper of the initiative presents a guideline to standardize and facilitate the writing and reviewing process of biomedical image analysis challenges.

name.justification: The paper's main focus is on challenges within the biomedical image analysis domain.
name.quote: Biomedical image analysis challenges: Open competition on specific scientific problems in the field of biomedical image analysis.

name.justification: The broader research field that encompasses the techniques and challenges discussed in the paper.
name.quote: For example, a challenge may target the problem of anatomical structure segmentation in computed tomography (CT) images.
